goal: Deliver the secure first Developer MVP slice: assigned-report dashboard and editable-note database guardrail.
acceptance_criteria: Only an authenticated user whose profile role is developer can load the dashboard.
The dashboard lists only reports assigned to the current developer and has loading, empty, error, and denied states.
Developer input limits are validated before lifecycle operations.
Investigation notes can be edited only by their author before QA handoff and are read-only after handoff.
